blocks.text: Sun Life Grepa Financial Inc. (Sun Life Grepa), one of the country’s leading life insurance providers, was named as one of HR Asia’s Best Companies to Work for in Asia 2026. This recognition underscores the company’s commitment to talent development, employee engagement, and creating an environment that acknowledges the contributions of its people. “This award is a shared achievement of the company and its employees, whose dedication and commitment demonstrate Sun Life Grepa’s values and culture in their everyday work” said Richard S.
